notes.title: Meet Orbit Outlaws
notes.notes:
Well, every studio has a story, and sometimes it's a messy one. Five years ago, we'd never built a game and knew less about how to run a team. With the best intention in the world, we put Moonshot out there and watched amazed as players enjoyed thrills and laughs together in this little project.

Now, five years later, after more side roads and detours than a Pittsburgh intersection, we're back on our feet and finally realizing the vision we had in mind back then. And so, I'm delighted to finally introduce you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1319100/Orbit_Outlaws/]Orbit Outlaws[/url], an all-new experience based on the ideas that sparked Moonshot! So gather your friends and join the fun this holiday with our free demo [bold].

Above all, we want to thank everyone who loved and played Moonshot in those early days.  To you, our earliest supporters, we are offering a free copy of Orbit Outlaws! Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/hYmdrbX]Discord[/url] and share in the Feedback channel your favorite thing about Moonshot, and I'll DM you a free key. 

Thank you! And let this new era of Galactic Games begin!

notes.title: Announcing Online Matchmaking
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QToEGT0.gif[/img]
Peanut butter and jelly, Mario and Luigi, Batman and Robin. The best things in life come in pairs.

That’s why we’re bringing together a perfect pairing this weekend. First, we’re introducing Online Matchmaking for the first time ever. Wait?!? Did an indie dev just say Online Matchmaking?!? That’s right! Online Matchmaking! Turns out a lot of people wanted it, so we've added it (here's looking at you, Ghojo/ Devastator/Forever Zed/X-oR Belgium... etc).

And what pairs better with Online Matchmaking than full lobbies! That’s why we’re celebrating launch with a Free Weekend! From 10:00 am PDT tomorrow thru Sunday at 1:00 pm, anyone can play Moonshot completely free. Top to bottom, local and online, all modes and maps completely free.

Tell your friends. Let the carnage begin!

Oh, and may the fourth be with you :)

notes.title: Network Multiplayer Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xT1XGOLotVcfrnM8HC/giphy.gif[/img]

You asked for it, so we pulled out all the stops! We're incredibly excited to announce the release of NETWORK MULTIPLAYER! Now you can link arms accross the globe and sing [url=https://youtu.be/IgwVW6KoF-M]Kumbaya[/url] to the tune of Moonshot!

With this release also comes an improved menu system, including an updated main menu screen, player select screen, and a simple system to invite your Steam friends into glorious rounds of orbital kung fu. There are still a few items that haven't been ported to network multiplayer, but we don't want that to stop you from blowing up your amigos online!

Finally, we're serving up all this chocolatey goodness alongside a 30 percent discount that's runs through this week, so snap it up now! We really want to keep you happy so please send us any feedback or suggestions you have. 

Have at it!! We love you!
The Moonshot Crew

notes.title: [BETA] Maps & Modes in Networked Play
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.meme.am/instances/500x/67136862.jpg[/img]
Hey everybody, great news! We've  just updated the Multiplayer Beta branch to add MAPS and MODES! This should breathe some fresh life into the networked play for all you Beta testers out there. 

This update also resolves the issue with level 2 and 3 homing missiles blowing up on firing. We've also dialed back Siege mode strength and sped up the transform time on Flight mode by popular request. There's a raft of other minor fixes as well.

As always, you can access it by going to the Steam Library and right click Moonshot. From the context menu, select Properties. Select the Betas tab and choose Networked Multiplayer from the drop down. 

Thanks for the all the feedback and testing! Let us know what you think in the comments below!

P.S. My post is about two days behind the update, so some of you may have it already. Sorry - it's been a busy week!

notes.title: Progress Update!
notes.notes:
Hello super amazing awesome people of Steam! We’ve got some exciting news to report. Over the past few days, we’ve seen a significant uptick in sales, all of which seems to due to word of mouth. We’d like to express a sincere thanks to all of you backers who’ve been spreading the good word. 

We’d like nothing more than to grow Moonshot to its full potential, and sales help make that possible. We’re learning that Steam reviews make play a critical role in driving sales. So, we have a favor to ask. If you’ve been playing and enjoying Moonshot, please take a few minutes to post a review – doesn’t have to be an essay, even something very simple would mean a lot to us! Please help us get 100 reviews!

Lastly, I wanted to share a bit about a feature we’re working on. Love it? Hate it? Let me know!

[b]Feature spotlight: Coins[/b]

When a tank or a pilot is destroyed, coins are ejected into space. Collecting coins from a destroyed tank awards a score bonus. We hope that, by introducing coin collecting, we promote more risk taking among players and more dynamic matches. Moonshot's at it's best when tanks are on the move!

Thank you!
Brent

notes.title: [BETA] Public Multiplayer Beta Is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.soinnovate.com/invite.gif[/img]

A huge thanks to everyone who’s been testing in private beta! The response has been inspiring, and collectively you’ve amassed dozens of hours of test coverage. Best of all, I’ve had the privilege of interacting personally with so many of you. It’s been humbling to experience your enthusiasm, support, and creativity first hand. 

Thanks to you, we’re ready to move our multiplayer build into public Beta! We hope this move broadens our funnel and increases the amount of feedback and coverage we’re getting. Note that this is still an EARLY BETA, and as such, many features are still disabled including map and mode selection, power ups, solar flares, tank bump, and tank smash. We’re still working on them.

To access it, go to the Steam Library and right click Moonshot. From the context menu, select Properties. Select the Betas tab and choose Networked Multiplayer from the drop down.

Lastly, if you’re enjoying yourselves, please take a moment to review us on Steam. Even a simple statement is appreciated, and every review counts!

Thanks for being wonderful fantastic people. All our love!

The Moonshot Team

notes.title: [BETA] Private Match Invite Patch 0.3.3
notes.notes:
A big thanks to everyone who's been testing! Your chat messages have added +10 to developer motivation:
[list]
    [*][i]"Yeah thats the most fun I've had in a game in awhile"[/i]
    [*][i]"man... straight up we love your game!"[/i]
    [*][i]"Best 8 dollars I've probably ever spent!"[/i]
[/list]
We've fixed the bug that required all players to restart the game between every match. We also caught and fixed a bug where the level you last played locally gets used in online matches, causing everything to catch fire (thanks Brynx!). 

We've also re-enabled respawn shields and synchronized Siege and Pulse shield charge levels. I also dialed back the strength of the Siege shield slightly by popular request.

Next big milestone - re-introduce level select screen so you can pick maps and add AI.

notes.title: [BETA] Get your Multiplayer on!
notes.notes:
Hello beautiful people! We just published our first ever online multiplayer beta build!! And we need your help to validate it! 

It’s in a private beta branch right now since we’re looking for direct feedback on your experience.  Add me as a friend on Steam and I’ll send you the password and instructions to download it.

If you’ve got a friend you’d like to play with who doesn’t own a copy, [b]I’ll get you a key![/b] It’s time to pulverize them with the skills you’ve been honing. 

Note that this is an EARLY BETA, and as such, many features are disabled including map and mode selection, power ups, solar flares, tank bump, and tank smash. Latency may be an issue for some. We want to hear about it!

Love all you guys!

[b]Known issues:[/b]
•	For players other than the host, bullets fired on a planet will arc unexpectedly
•	Respawn shield doesn’t defend against bullets
•	Siege and Pulse shield energy remaining isn’t synced for remote players
•	Asteroids can’t be destroyed
•	Occasionally, points will be awarded multiple times for the same kill

notes.title: Minor Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today we’re rolling out an important update to the AI behavior. Previously, when the AI determined it couldn’t reach a target from any point on its local planet, it would just idle.

Today we're improving that. Sam’s got an awesome update that makes AI tanks fly to a planet nearer to their target when they can’t get a shot. It’s not perfect by any means, but it makes a significant difference in match dynamics. We didn’t want to sit on it while we finished our next two week update, so we’re getting it out to you today.

We hope you enjoy the update.

Brent

notes.title: Moonshot’s First Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xT77XZju3Kokvv5KKY/giphy.gif[/img]

Hey guys! Thanks for playing and loving Moonshot! We’re delighted about the positive response we’ve had so far. I hope you’re as excited as we are.

You represent the new and the proud – the first adopters who will shape the product with us! We want to hear from you, the good, the bad, and the ugly!

This update addresses a handful of rough spots we’ve heard from you so far. It also introduces our third power up – [u][b]the Point Defense Drone![/b][/u] Laugh as it annihilates your opponent’s best placed shots, then obliterate them with your own. 

We’re also introducing some changes to aiming for controller players that allows you to more easily point and fire in the direction of your stick.  We could use some feedback here as this is a nuanced system.

Full patch notes are below. [b]Is something missing that you’d like to see? Let us know, let us know, let us know![/b] Next update again in two weeks.

P.S. We've heard you loud and clear. [b]We're pushing hard on networked multiplayer.[/b] It's a doozy. 
 
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
•	Made reticle travel more smoothly across the vertical
•	Removed the restricted turret angle on the rover – you can now shoot 360 degrees!
•	Accelerated Siege tank charge shots so they shoot further faster
•	Increased turret rotation speed with all tank modes and weapon types
•	New thruster jetpack effect for pilot helps communicate you can steer
•	Implemented Point Defense Drone Levels 1, 2, and 3
•	Point Defense Drone color messages when it’s ready to fire
•	Fix out of memory crash in Round Summary and Pause screens
•	Performance improvements on Basic quality
•	Minor perf improvements all over
•	Change default quality to Good
•	Change the quality control button to be more clear
•	Tuned smash velocity
•	Tuned homing missiles and lasers to make them less murderous
•	Auto-select the recommended System for the selected game mode
•	Persist the selected System between rounds
•	Added material to pilot backpack model
•	Prevent solar pulse from destroying tanks in a respawn shield
•	Fix bug where tanks aren’t destroyed when colliding with the sun while in respawn shield 
•	Fix bug where you can shoot yourself while transforming
•	AI improvements
•	Renamed Systems Antares and Omicron to Haven and Parilus
•	Tune the game camera to keep tanks in view
•	New sound effects for tank stomp and pilot smear
•	Fixed bug where homing missiles can home in on you or your team
•	Fixed bug with pulse shield never expiring when hit with a laser
•	Locked the cursor onto the window in windowed mode
•	Added support for borderless window mode from Steam properties menu
